comments:
The manuscript covers the chapter on perception (mngon sum le'u).
[8H6M69W4] identifies the author as "ne'u thog pa chos kyi bla ma'i slob ma," who is understood to be the same person as "ye shes dpal," the author of the previous item (see (ID:6013)), which covers the chapter on inference for oneself from what appears to be the same work.
name: tshad ma rnam par nges pa'i Tik+ka mngon sum le'u
